item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Damini draws ray $OD$ from the vertex of $\angle XOY$, as in the figure.

Which two claims are correct?

options.A: The printed label ray on $OD$ is enough to show that $OD$ bisects $\angle XOY$.
options.B: $OD$ bisects $\angle XOY$ when $\angle XOD$ equals $\angle DOY$.
options.C: $OD$ must start at the vertex $O$ of $\angle XOY$ to be able to bisect it.
options.D: $OD$ bisects $\angle XOY$ whenever $OD$ lies somewhere between $OX$ and $OY$.
